Exploratory Data Analysis

Results

Methods, in brief. Participant-level models (one baseline visit per person predicting the future outcome), 5-fold stratified cross-validation, SMOTE inside training folds only. Conversion = a worse stage sustained across ≥2 visits. Cohorts: CN→progression n=519, MCI→Dementia n=819, Pooled→AD n=1338. CSF p-tau181 corrected to its 8–120 pg/mL scale; 33 predictors. Reproducible from notebooks 07–08 (seed 42).
